meta_data.base_class: Analyze the sentiment of news articles related to <celebrities> over a specific time period - refers to various individuals across different fields who can be featured in news reports, such as athletes, musicians, writers, chefs, and actors.

tool_template.name: <class>SentimentAnalysis.performAnalysis
tool_template.description: Analyzes the sentiment of news articles related to <class> over a specified time period, using advanced natural language processing techniques.

entity.description: The name of the <class> to analyze.

sources.description: List of news sources to include in the analysis.

language.description: The language of the articles to analyze.

sentimentThreshold.description: The minimum sentiment score to consider for reporting, ranging from -1 (very negative) to 1 (very positive).

analysisDepth.description: The level of detail the analysis should go into, with higher values providing deeper analysis.

outputFormat.description: The format in which the analysis results should be presented, either be 'summary' or 'detailed'.

includeQuotes.description: Whether to include direct quotes from the news articles related to the <class> in the analysis.

region.description: The geographic region from which the news articles should be sourced for the analysis.

historicalComparison.description: Whether to include a comparison of current sentiment with historical sentiment data for the <class>.
